title: Obedience
description: Obeying God isn't about earning his love — it's the natural response of loving him back, and it's for our good.

waypoints.title: Love in Action
waypoints.body: Jesus said loving him and obeying him go together -- not as a way to earn his favor, but as the natural response of someone who already has it.

waypoints.title: First Time, Cheerful
waypoints.body: Practice quick, cheerful obedience the first time you're asked this week -- no arguing, no repeating.
